response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development, including C and C++ (e.g., National Instruments), but lacks direct experience with C++ in modern industrial automation contexts (e.g., STL, multi-threading, message brokers). His recent work focuses heavily on TypeScript, Node.js, and D, with limited exposure to cloud platforms, REST/MQTT for industrial IoT, or IEC 62443 security standards. His strengths lie in software craftsmanship and cross-domain expertise, but these do not align closely with the role's core requirements.
strengths: Strong background in C/C++ (National Instruments experience)
Extensive hands-on experience with software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, agile)
Proven ability to learn new languages and frameworks quickly
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience in industrial automation or high-performance systems
No demonstrated exposure to IEC 62443, secure coding practices, or industrial cybersecurity standards
Lack of experience with message brokers, REST/MQTT, or cloud platforms (e.g., Azure)

key_factors.factor: Cloud and IoT platform experience (REST/MQTT, Azure)
